question: With videoMetadata startOffset/endOffset on an inline video part, are the model's MM:SS times counted from the clip's start or from the window's start?
route: Firebase AI Logic web SDK (firebase 13.4.0), ONLY_IN_CLOUD, Gemini Developer API backend, App Check limited-use token, signed-in user, local dev origin http://127.0.0.1:5173

clip.content: grey frame; a red 40x40 square visible only from 8.0 s to 12.0 s

prompt: A red square is in this video. Give the time it first appears and the time it is last visible, as MM:SS from the start of the video.
reading: Counted from the clip's start: a window-relative answer would have been 00:02 to 00:06. lastSeen 00:11 is the last whole second before the square's last frame at 11.9 s.
caveat: One call, one model, one synthetic clip. It settles the default reading for the triage design; it is not an accuracy measurement. Repeat on the staged clips before any claim.
